# `gateway.configure`

Set model-gateway policy (provider/model/data-class allowlist, timeout). BOTH egress switches are explicit and default OFF; enabling operator egress never enables EXTERNAL egress — that is a separate explicit switch. Raw/quarantined can never be allowlisted.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice gateway-configure`
- **MCP tool:** `gateway_configure` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `str` | optional, default=None |  |
| `model` | `str` | optional, default=None |  |
| `allowed_data_classes` | `json` | optional, default=None | JSON list of allowed data classes |
| `enable_operator_egress` | `bool` | optional, default=False |  |
| `enable_external_egress` | `bool` | optional, default=False | A separate switch from operator egress; it must be turned on explicitly and stays off by default. |
| `timeout_ms` | `int` | optional, default=20000 |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice gateway-configure
```

_Synthesized from this operation's required arguments._

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `ineligible_data_class` | Raw or quarantined data can never be allowed to leave the machine, so it cannot be allowlisted. |
